ttresearch.page.PERIPHERALS.0:
Thaumic Tinkerer allows for some of the blocks that it adds, alongside some vanilla Thaumcraft blocks, to be used as ComputerCraft peripherals: with CC: Tweaked installed, a computer next to one of them, or connected to it by a wired modem, finds it with peripheral.wrap or peripheral.find by the peripheral type that the following pages name.

The following pages list the methods of each peripheral. A call waits for the next tick of the world. Without CC: Tweaked these blocks work as ordinary blocks.
ttresearch.page.PERIPHERALS.1:
Dynamism Tablet: tt_animationTablet

getRedstone(), setRedstone(boolean): whether the tablet waits for a redstone signal (Redstone Control mode).
getLeftClick(), setLeftClick(boolean): true for the left click, false for the right click.
getRotation(), setRotation(number): the side the tablet faces, 0 north, 1 south, 2 west, 3 east; any other number is an error.
hasItem(): whether the tablet holds an item.
trigger(): the tablet does its action once, even if it normally wouldn't, and answers true; false while it is already working.
ttresearch.page.PERIPHERALS.2:
Kinetic and Corporeal Attractor: tt_magnet

isPulling(), setPulling(boolean): true while the attractor pulls (blue), false while it pushes (red).
getSignal(): the redstone signal applied to it, 0 to 15.

The Corporeal Attractor also has getAdultSearch() and setAdultSearch(boolean): true when it moves adult animals, false for children.
ttresearch.page.PERIPHERALS.3:
Aspectalyzer: tt_aspectanalyzer

hasItem(): whether there is an item in it.
itemHasAspects(): whether that item has aspects.
getAspects(): a list of the names of the item's aspects.
getAspectCount(): a table from the name of each aspect of the item to its amount.
ttresearch.page.PERIPHERALS.4:
Golem Connector: tt_golemconnector

The golem bound to it: getType(), getCore(), getHealth(), getDecorations() (a list), getPosition() (x, y, z), getHome() and setHome(x, y, z, facing) (both answer x, y, z, facing).
Its markers: getMarkers(), setMarkers(list), getMarkerCount(), getMarker(n), addMarker(marker), saveMarker(n, marker), deleteMarker(n); n counts from 0. A marker is a table of posX, posY, posZ, dim, side and color; newMarker() gives one at the connector without saving it.
Without a golem in reach these answer nothing.
ttresearch.page.PERIPHERALS.5:
Everything that has aspects you can see with Goggles of Revealing (jars, alembics, nodes, node jars, the Essentia Funnel, the Thaumic Restorer, and the Transvector Interface, which answers for the block it is bound to): tt_aspectContainer

getAspects(): a list of the names of the aspects in it.
getAspectCount(name): the amount of that aspect in it, 0 when there is none.
ttresearch.page.PERIPHERALS.6:
Blocks that essentia tubes connect to and that hold no aspects you can see (essentia tubes and valves, the base of the Arcane Bore): tt_aspectTransport

All methods but the last take a side: 0 down, 1 up, 2 north, 3 south, 4 west, 5 east.
isConnectable(side), canInputFrom(side), canOutputTo(side): true or false.
getSuctionType(side), getEssentiaType(side): the name of the aspect; an error when there is none.
getSuctionAmount(side), getEssentiaAmount(side): numbers.
getMinimumSuction(): a number.
ttresearch.page.PERIPHERALS.7:
Thaumcraft's machines

Deconstruction Table, tt_deconstructor: hasItem(), hasAspect(), getAspect() (the name of the aspect waiting on it; nothing while there is none).
Brain in a Jar, tt_braininajar: getXP(), the experience stored in it.
Arcane Ear, tt_arcaneear: getNote(), setNote(number): the note it listens for, 0 to 24.
Arcane Bore, tt_arcanebore: hasPickaxe(), hasFocus(), isPickaxeBroken() (one use left), isWorking(), getRadius() (the width of the hole it digs), getSpeed(), hasNativeClusters(), getFortune(), hasSilkTouch().
ttresearch.page.PERIPHERALS.8:
Dissipating Turtle

A turtle crafted with a Fume Dissipator next to it carries the Dissipator as a tool. turtle.dig() then dissolves every gas in a cube of six blocks around the turtle, as the Dissipator does in a sneaking hand, and answers true.
